Loading slicer paths…

Near-side lid mount close-up. Select Isometric to restore the whole base.

Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom. These are extrusion centerlines, not solid beads. Travel and startup/purge paths are omitted. Layers retain their actual heights.

Bambu Studio 2.9.1.70 · P2S 0.4 mm · Generic PETG · 0.20 mm layers · four walls · 25% gyroid · automatic tree supports, including supports on the part. All three slices use identical settings; support reduction comes from the geometry.

Solid motor foot

The unused opening below the NEMA17 face is filled down to the floor, removing its unsupported underside.

Pitched side windows

45° roofs replace broad horizontal window tops. The narrower openings close gradually as layers rise.

Access from underneath

Four 23 × 11 mm openings beneath the bearing and bolt shelves let supports reach the bed and provide tool access for removal. The bearing seats and carrier guide walls remain intact.

Motor-side lid mounts

The current base replaces the hanging mounts with gussets rooted into the motor wall. With the same slicer settings, neither mount region contains support or support-interface paths. Total support material falls from 7.0 g to 4.2 g compared with the preceding base. Select Before lid braces and Lid mounts to inspect the difference.

Full printability comparison

Loading comparison…

Support totals are calculated from the G-code’s support and interface extrusion. Area totals group paths by position; they do not certify removability. Shelf-support weight increases locally because those trees now extend down through the floor to the bed. Some supports remain beneath axles and other overhangs. Print fit and support removal still need a physical trial.
